verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents an official programmatic surface it brands the "Admin SDK", including the Reports API and the Directory API (users.list, user/admin creation, device management), plus first-party Apps Script for automating Admin console tasks. However, the evidence shows only REST references and a low-code scripting environment, not language client libraries. missing for 10: evidence of official language-specific SDK/client libraries (e.g. Python/Node/Java packages), SDK coverage beyond admin APIs (Gmail/Drive/Docs), AI-agent-oriented SDK guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
